author: Yoonz
quote:
Unfortunately the game was not what it was advertised as in the trailers. Yes, the graphics are pretty and the introduction plays sort of like a small movie. But once you get past the first hour, it all falls apart.

I've gotten stuck in weird boxes, lost my progress of up to more than an hour easily multiple times. And quite frankly? The game really just doesn't run well at all!

I own a normal playstation, the game was advertised as being for the playstation five and I just cannot see how anyone would approve this kind of performance at a price point of nearly 100 bucks.

Really, really disappointed.
